candidates.excerpt: Social media influencer Dhruv Rathee was detained from his residence in Gurugram-by-Gurugram Police on Saturday, ahead of the protest at Jantar Mantar in Delhi.

candidates.title: Prakash Reddy Demands Priyank Kharge’s Resignation over EC Remark
candidates.excerpt: Reddy accused Congress leaders of deliberately issuing statements aimed at discrediting constitutional institutions

candidates.title: Elon Musk posts ‘Dear Prime Minister Ambani,’ alleges monopoly over Starlink’s India entry
candidates.excerpt: SpaceX and Tesla CEO Elon Musk on Friday took another swipe at billionaire Mukesh Ambani over Starlink's entry into India, calling him "Dear Prime Minister Ambani,” and accusing him of seeking to maintain a monopoly and questioning whether he would allow the satellite internet service to compete in the country.

candidates.title: 36 people hurt after shopping mall ceiling collapses in South Korea’s Daegu city
candidates.excerpt: About 70 people evacuated the facility after the collapse, with President Lee Jae Myung instructing officials to ensure a thorough response

candidates.title: 7.2-magnitude earthquake strikes Panama
candidates.excerpt: A 7.2-magnitude earthquake struck Panama, with its epicentre 39 kilometres northwest of Tonosi, a town in Los Santos province, according to a revised report from the University of Panama's Institute of Geosciences.

candidates.title: UN Raises Alarm Over Mass Detentions During Delhi Protests
candidates.excerpt: Hundreds of protesters were detained as security forces prevented a planned demonstration by the Gen Z-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) from reaching Jantar Mantar in central Delhi.

candidates.title: Top Court To Hold Special Hearing Tomorrow On Metro Closure, Protest Detentions
candidates.excerpt: A bench comprising Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana is scheduled to hear the matters.
